title: 2017 AMC 8 Problem 17
statement: Starting with some gold coins and some empty treasure chests, I tried to put \(9\) gold coins in each treasure chest, but that left \(2\) treasure chests empty. So instead I put \(6\) gold coins in each treasure chest, but then I had \(3\) gold coins left over. How many gold coins did I have?

solutions.text:
Let \(n\) be the number of treasure chests and \(g\) be the number of gold coins. Then \[9(n - 2) = g\] and \[6n + 3 = g.\] Solving this system yields \(n = 7,\) so the number of gold coins is \(6 \cdot 7 + 3 = 45.\)

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Let \(n\) be the number of treasure chests.
Write one equation for the \(9\)-coins attempt and another for the \(6\)-coins attempt.
